# Benchmarking LLM performance for classifying medical devices

## Benchmark results

We have assessed the performance of a range of LLM models against a test set of 150 devices. These range from smaller, open-weight models to frontier, closed-weight models.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message= FALSE, echo=FALSE, dpi = 150}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
benchmark_models <- c(
  "google/gemma-3-12b-it",
  "google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it",
  "google/gemma-4-31b-it",
  "meta-llama/llama-4-maverick",
  "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash",
  "openai/gpt-oss-120b",
  "openai/gpt-6-luna",
  "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017",
  "google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite",
  "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5",
  "google/gemini-3.8-flash",
  "mistralai/mistral-large-4-0",
  "google/gemini-4-hydrogen",
  "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5",
  "openai/gpt-5.5",
  "openai/gpt-6.2-sol"
)
benchmark_summary <- readr::read_csv(here::here("vignettes", "benchmark_summary.csv"))

benchmark_summary |>
  filter(model %in% benchmark_models) |> 
  mutate(model = factor(model,
                        levels = benchmark_models)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = accuracy, y = column, colour = model)) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = accuracy),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_label(
    aes(label = paste0(round(accuracy, 0), "%")),
    hjust = 1.25,
    fill = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(model), ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x = "Accuracy (%)",
    y = NULL,
    colour = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Testing an LLM
If not one of the above, we recommend testing your LLM against the test set. For this, use the `evaluateDeviceClassifier()` function against the test data provider by the package like below.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(MedicalDeviceClassifier)
library(ellmer)

chat <- chat_anthropic()
res <- evaluateDeviceClassifier(chat,
                                name = benchmark_models,
                                data = device_test_set,
                                batchSize = 15L)
```

You can also use `evaluateDeviceClassifier()` to test the impact of different batch sizes and also provide your own custom test data.
